**Finding: deviation (LICENSE — Licence grant scope)**

- **What complies:** The Section 2 grants are not revocable at will — 2.1 is expressly "perpetual and irrevocable" and 2.2 is royalty-free, fully paid up and perpetual. Transferability to a successor is preserved via Section 14.1, which permits assignment in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets without consent. Contractor use is largely accommodated indirectly (Corio Servers are those "owned or operated by *or for* Corio", plus unlimited Customer sublicensing under 2.1(iv)).
- **What fails:** Every grant runs to "Corio" only. Our affiliates are not covered anywhere and there is no notice mechanism to add them — this misses even the fallback position ("Affiliates covered on written notice").
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** New Section 2.11 extending all Section 2 licences to Corio's affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf, with Corio responsible for their compliance; written-notice affiliate limitation offered as fallback in the comment.
